name: uams-web/inside-uams
description: Development-only Composer setup for the InsideUAMS child theme. It installs nothing into production.

scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan over the first-party code.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:sweep: Apply Rector's sweep profile; review the diff.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:refactor: Preview Rector's gating profile; fails when it would change a file.
scripts-descriptions.pint: Format the first-party code with Pint.
scripts-descriptions.test:pint: Check formatting with Pint; fails when it would change a file.
